mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month, it signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and industrial production is accelerating month-over-month, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when INDPRO > 55 and accelerating.
